Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial multi-tenant booking system setup with tenant management

- Set up .NET 9 solution with API \(FastEndpoints\), Web \(Blazor Server\), and Contracts projects
- Implemented multi-tenancy foundation with tenant resolution middleware
- Created tenant management endpoints \(Create, Get, List\) following vertical slice architecture
- Configured Marten document store with PostgreSQL for tenant storage
- Integrated Serilog for structured logging
- Set up MudBlazor UI component library
- Configured CORS for Blazor UI communication
- Added FluentValidation for request validation
- Established strongly-typed TenantId value object for type safety

Architecture follows SOLID principles, vertical slice architecture, and Microsoft C# coding conventions.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Complete multi-tenant booking system with authentication and subscription features

API Backend:
- Authentication system with JWT tokens and secure password hashing
- User registration with provider/client roles and invitation codes
- Multi-tenant organization management with trial subscriptions
- Booking system with approval/rejection workflow
- Schedule management for providers
- Subscription plans and tenant subscription management
- Analytics endpoints for revenue and usage statistics
- Creation codes for controlled tenant registration
- Trial validation middleware with daily booking limits

Web Frontend:
- Blazor Server UI with MudBlazor components
- Authentication flows \(login, register, organization setup\)
- Multi-step organization registration wizard with:
  - Auto-generated subdomain from organization name
  - OpenStreetMap Nominatim location autocomplete \(Philippines\)
  - Operating hours configuration
  - Data Privacy Act compliance checkboxes
- Interactive Server rendermode for all pages
- Mobile-responsive landing page with features and pricing
- Custom authentication state provider with local storage
- Dashboard with quick stats and actions
- EmptyLayout for public pages, MainLayout for authenticated

Technical Improvements:
- Vertical slice architecture for API features
- Strong typing with strongly-typed IDs
- Frontend engineer guidelines for UI/UX design principles
- Project backlog tracking

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
